title: How We Shipped More Code in 3 Weeks Than 3 Months Combined
description:
In just three weeks, our team shipped more code than we did in the previous two months combined. How? By adopting an AI-native workflow with strategic use of tools like Cursor, Claude, and Conductor. It sounds ambitious, but it's a reality. 

The shift, led by rethinking our traditional development workflow, has significantly boosted our developer velocity. We've maintained quality and enhanced our deployment processes, showing that speed doesn't have to compromise the integrity of our releases.

What we cover:
• What drove the change from traditional development to AI-native workflows?
• How did tools like Cursor, Claude, and Conductor transform our process?
• Can AI-native workflows support both speed and quality?
• Tips for leveraging coding agents in daily tasks.
• The role of feedback loops in enhancing the development cycle.

Chapters:
00:25 - Intro: Is Your Development Speed Stuck in "Low Gear"?
04:15 - The Old Way vs. The New Way: Defining the AI-Native Workflow.
05:09 - Mastering "Plan Mode" in Cursor.
07:54 - The Importance of Feedback Loops: How Velocity Meets Quality.
11:16 - Using skills
15:25 - Parallelisation
20:40 - Cloud Agents
26:36 - Questions
